with open('src/state/save.ts', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the finishMail method
new_lines = []
skip_until_brace = False
brace_count = 0

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'finishMail()' in line:
        # Skip until the closing brace of the method
        for j in range(i, len(lines)):
            new_lines.append(lines[j])
            if '{' in lines[j]:
                brace_count += 1
            if '}' in lines[j]:
                brace_count -= 1
                if brace_count == 0:
                    # Found the closing brace, now replace the body
                    new_lines.pop()  # Remove the closing brace
                    new_lines.pop()  # Remove the blank line
                    new_lines.pop()  # Remove the empty line before the method
                    new_lines.append('  finishMail(this: Store, quest: MailQuest) {\n')
                    new_lines.append('    if (quest.item && quest.to) {\n')
                    new_lines.append('      const mem = this.data.mail.memory ?? {};\n')
                    new_lines.append('      const items = mem[quest.to] ?? [];\n')
                    new_lines.append('      // Keep only the newest 3 items\n')
                    new_lines.append('      this.data.mail.memory = {\n')
                    new_lines.append('        ...mem,\n')
                    new_lines.append('        [quest.to]: [quest.item, ...items].slice(0, 3),\n')
                    new_lines.append('      };\n')
                    new_lines.append('    }\n')
                    new_lines.append('    this.data.mail.quest = null;\n')
                    new_lines.append('    this.data.mail.delivered += 1;\n')
                    new_lines.append('    this.data.quests.active = null;\n')
                    new_lines.append('    this.commit();\n')
                    new_lines.append('  }\n')
                    break
        break

# Write the rest of the file
for line in lines:
    new_lines.append(line)

with open('src/state/save.ts', 'w') as f:
    f.writelines(new_lines)

print("File updated successfully")
EOF
